headline: AI agents cut SBA compliance review times, according to a case study
body: First Internet Bank of Indiana has cut compliance review times for Small Business Administration (SBA) loan applicants by 87% using AI agents, according to a case study from Bretton AI. Reviews that took eight to 10 hours now take less than an hour.
note: The case is about capacity, with the bank growing and more files for the same analysts. The $6 billion-asset digital bank plans to use the freed capacity to take on more business, according to PYMNTS.

evidence.text: First Internet Bank of Indiana has cut compliance review times for Small Business Administration (SBA) loan applicants by 87% using AI agents, according to a case study from artificial intelligence compliance company Bretton AI .
Reviews that took eight to 10 hours now take less than an hour.
The $6 billion-asset digital bank plans to use the freed capacity to take on more business, not to reduce headcount.
